report:
Independently reassessed the complete claim, ordinary span.rs association, both ordinary movement tests and explicit TODO test. Exact byte comparison against historical input.json confirmed span.rs, representation_spec.rs and sage-test-harness/lib.rs are unchanged; historical approval was context, not a replacement for this assessment.
The claim distinguishes edits outside an item which only move its absolute range, allowed diagnostic/position updates, equality of relative CST and typed content, and no invalidation of semantic consumers that did not read absolute coordinates. RelativeSpan derives equality and stores only relative start/end; AbsoluteSpan separately stores source and absolute coordinates and resolve adds the base. This establishes the representation mechanism, not the entire incremental guarantee.
The generated-item test inserts a leading newline and explicitly asserts identical derive expansion ID and changed origin start. It proves that narrow identity/coordinate scenario, not semantic-value equality. The associated-method test forces a target body, checks empty diagnostics and an empty warm execution trace, inserts an earlier sibling in both trait and impl, forces the target again, and compares the complete sorted execution-name trace. The expected traces contain owner/item reconstruction but no target signature/body execution. Captured setup_root_module context establishes source-text consumption; captured database event logging records WillExecute and take_query_log drains it, supporting the reuse interpretation.
The TODO test is empty and contributes no behavioral evidence. Its explicit prerequisite is extending plain/generated insertion/removal edit tests to compare resolved positions, semantic values, and downstream query reuse. It therefore retains the broader matrix, direct relative CST/typed equality checks, removal scenarios and position/diagnostic consumer behavior beyond the examples. Full implementation/verification is not asserted; the conditional no-propagation guarantee remains partially evidenced and visibly deferred. No N/A entries exist. The current TODO rationale is specific and adequate; no requested edits.
Validation was source inspection and exact historical-byte comparison. I executed review start/read and this recording, not behavioral tests or a workspace build. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and root build are separate execution evidence, not my execution or proof of this claim. Additional relied-on helper context was captured through review read.
